generation.prompt: Create ONE 2048x2048 production PROJECTILE ANIMATION ATLAS: exact FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 cells of 512x512 pixels. Premium detailed crisp hard-aliased 32-bit pixel art. ALL background/gutters UNIFORMLY flat pure green #00FF00 everywhere outside sprites. No green illumination or glow. Retain every projectile source color. Each sprite isolated centered in its cell, LEFT-pointing, full motif and particles fit inside central 55% width AND height, at least22.5% empty margin on every side, no boundary contact or overflow. Preserve size differences between rows, never enlarge every motif to equal size. Source phase 2: tall gold-and-navy mirror gantry with pairs of pale cyan rectangular mirrors, glowing rainbow central prism, magenta base and optical rail arms. ROW 1, weapon A: long thin rainbow-white refraction ray, from short underslung rainbow-core barrel on lower front chassis. Visibly long narrow, approximate extent 48% cell width and 11% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 2, weapon B: compact pale-cyan mirror-glass shard, from separate twin mirror-rail weapon along lower side chassis. Visibly small compact, approximate extent 21% cell width and 21% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 3, weapon C: wide hexagonal rainbow light ring, from lowest pivoting gold optical cannon beneath chassis. Visibly broad wide, approximate extent 38% cell width and 28% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 4, weapon heavy: large multifaceted rainbow diamond capsule, from central rainbow prism amplifier. Visibly large heavy, approximate extent 44% cell width and 34% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. The corresponding boss weapon A/B/C muzzle birth must match that row colors, shape and material. No translation across cells. Different projectile sizes are artwork fitted to existing game hazard bounds; keep original timing, speed, paths, damage and count.
